exposure: Abdominal delivery in intact amniotic sac (delivered "en caul")
outcome: Morbidity rate during the first year of life
cohort: The study analysed 70 matched twin pairs who were delivered by Caesarean section.
finding: Neonates delivered "en caul" during Caesarean section showed improved Apgar scores, reduced need for resuscitation, lower mechanical ventilation term, shorter hospital stays, lower incidence of brain damage, and lower morbidity rates during the first year of life compared to those delivered by conventional Caesarean section.
mod_finding: Delivery via Caesarean section with the intact amniotic sac ("en caul") was associated with better neonatal outcomes compared to conventional Caesarean section delivery.
